disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与配置，未发现读取凭据文件（如凭证配置、SSH 私钥、云凭据）或批量枚举密钥的代码路径。
checked_items.en: All source code and configuration were inspected; no code path reading credential files (such as credential configuration, SSH private keys, cloud credentials) or batch-enumerating keys was found.

checked_items.zh: 错误分类逻辑中出现的「认证、API Key、凭据」等词仅用于把这类失败判定为永久性错误并跳过自动续跑，不涉及任何密钥读取。
checked_items.en: In the error classification logic, words like "authentication", "API key", and "credentials" are used only to classify such failures as permanent errors and skip automatic retries; they do not involve any key reading.

evidence.zh: 插件不读取 dsh 主机的凭据文件，也未发现任何读取敏感路径的代码，无凭据外泄面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not read credential files from the dsh host, and no code reading sensitive paths was found; there is no credential exfiltration surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部注册面：插件未注册任何工具描述，也未向系统提示注入片段，没有文本投毒载体。
checked_items.en: All registration surfaces were inspected: the plugin registers no tool descriptions, injects no snippets into the system prompt, and has no text-poisoning vector.

checked_items.zh: 检查了说明文档、界面文案与默认配置文本，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装或诱导安装等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Documentation, UI copy, and default configuration text were inspected; no injection wording such as instruction override, system-message spoofing, or installation inducement was found.

checked_items.zh: 未发现任何代理指令文件（如 AGENTS.md、SKILL.md、编辑器指令配置）。
checked_items.en: No agent instruction files (such as AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, or editor instruction configuration) were found.

evidence.zh: 无工具描述可投毒：插件未调用工具注册接口，仅向会话发送用户配置的续跑文本，属声明的自动继续功能。
evidence.en: No tool description is available for poisoning: the plugin does not call the tool registration interface and only sends user-configured continuation text to the session, which is the declared automatic-continue functionality.

evidence.zh: 无诱导安装措辞：插件不注册工具，说明文档中的安装指引为正常使用说明。
evidence.en: No installation-inducement wording: the plugin registers no tools, and the installation guidance in the documentation is normal usage instructions.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与构建产物，未发现动态代码执行、子进程调用或下载即执行等模式。
checked_items.en: All source code and build artifacts were scanned; no patterns such as dynamic code execution, subprocess invocation, or download-and-execute were found.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置仅含一行插件插入声明，不含任何脚本执行标签。
checked_items.en: The patch config contains only a single plugin-insertion declaration and no script execution tags.

checked_items.zh: 检查了项目内 CI 工作流与文档素材：两处 CI 工作流与三份 SVG 图及一份源码映射文件命中工作流存在性与超长行信号（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59、DSH-X08/DG-R3-60），逐条分析均为良性——CI 工作流只在 GitHub 平台运行、内容是标准检查与发布流程；SVG 为纯图形素材；源码映射文件由本项目构建脚本从可读 TypeScript 源码生成，并非混淆产物。
checked_items.en: CI workflows and documentation assets in the project were inspected: two CI workflows, three SVG images, and one source-map file matched the workflow-existence and overlong-line signals (DSH-X07/DG-R3-59, DSH-X08/DG-R3-60); item-by-item analysis showed all are benign—the CI workflows run only on the GitHub platform and contain standard checking and release processes; the SVGs are pure graphic assets; the source-map file is generated by this project's build script from readable TypeScript source, not an obfuscated artifact.

checked_items.zh: 未发现安装钩子：包清单无安装期脚本（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），prepack 仅在本仓库打包发布时执行构建，不属于 dsh 安装执行面。
checked_items.en: No install hook was found: the package manifest has no install-time scripts (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare), and prepack only runs the build when packaging releases from this repository, so it is not part of dsh's installation execution surface.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）为纯数据插入，无脚本执行标签，不存在配置即执行风险。
evidence.en: The patch config (cordis.patch.yml) is a pure data insertion with no script execution tags; there is no configuration-as-execution risk.

evidence.zh: 插件未接入动态包工具（未调用代码定义/执行接口），无自我修改面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not integrate dynamic package tools (it does not call code-definition/execution interfaces), leaving no self-modification surface.

evidence.zh: 无安装期钩子；项目内工作流仅在 CI 运行且内容为标准检查与发布流程。
evidence.en: No install-time hooks; in-project workflows run only in CI and contain standard checking and release processes.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器模块，已对浏览器打包产物专项检查：仅请求本机状态端点、展示设置卡片与浏览器通知，无键盘监听、剪贴板访问或凭据接口调用。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser module, and the browser bundle was specifically inspected: it only requests the local status endpoint, displays a settings card, and sends browser notifications; there is no keyboard listening, clipboard access, or credential-interface invocation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部外联面：代码中的网络请求仅指向本机 dsh 宿主的状态端点，无任何第三方域名或外部服务器地址。
checked_items.en: All outbound surfaces were inspected: network requests in the code point only to the local dsh host's status endpoint, with no third-party domains or external server addresses.

checked_items.zh: 说明文档中的徽章图片链接仅随 README 页面加载，不参与插件运行时行为。
checked_items.en: Badge image links in the documentation load only with the README page and do not participate in plugin runtime behavior.

evidence.zh: 无外联通道：插件不访问外部网络，也不读取凭据，不存在外泄组合面。
evidence.en: No outbound channel: the plugin does not access external networks nor read credentials, so there is no combined exfiltration surface.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：全部依赖为官方 @deepseek-ai 系列包与常规构建工具，未发现仿冒名或可疑来源依赖。
checked_items.en: The dependency manifest was verified: all dependencies are official @deepseek-ai packages and standard build tools; no name-impersonating or suspicious-source dependencies were found.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，也不含降权写法。
checked_items.en: The patch config does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and contains no privilege-lowering constructs.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对审批链等安全事件的前置监听或截断逻辑。
checked_items.en: No pre-listening or interception logic for security events such as approval chains was found.

checked_items.zh: 锁文件根版本号（0.8.0）与包版本（0.8.1）不一致，属开发期维护差异，不影响运行时依赖解析。
checked_items.en: The lockfile root version (0.8.0) differs from the package version (0.8.1); this is a development-phase maintenance difference and does not affect runtime dependency resolution.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件行，不覆盖任何安全配置。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts a plugin line and does not override any security configuration.

evidence.zh: 未监听审批/预执行等安全事件，无截断审批链的可能。
evidence.en: No listening on security events such as approval/pre-execution is present, so approval-chain interception is impossible.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无版本基线可比较升级自动激活行为。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; there is no version baseline to compare for upgrade auto-activation behavior.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写服务注入/拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch config does not modify service injection/interception configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时行为面：插件在宿主进程内监听会话事件并按配置自动发送续跑消息、执行循环守卫取消与重启回合，均与声明的自动继续业务一致，无异常行为。
checked_items.en: Runtime behavior surfaces were inspected: the plugin listens to session events within the host process and, per configuration, automatically sends continuation messages and executes loop-guard cancellation and restart rounds; all matches the declared automatic-continue business and shows no abnormal behavior.

checked_items.zh: 插件向宿主已有 web 服务器注册了两个本地路径（状态流与动作回传），未自行启动服务或监听端口；该宿主的本机无认证模型属 dsh 生态固有风险。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers two local paths (status stream and action callback) on the host's existing web server; it does not start its own service or listen on ports. The host's local unauthenticated access model is an inherent risk of the dsh ecosystem.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 web 服务或监听端口，仅复用宿主服务器注册本地路径；本机无认证的访问模型是宿主固有属性，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on ports; it only reuses the host server to register local paths. The local unauthenticated access model is an inherent host property, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：dsh 声明完整，挂载配置为简单插入，依赖均为官方包。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: dsh declarations are complete, the patch config is a simple insertion, and dependencies are all official packages.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未检出危险执行、外联或凭据访问模式。
summary.en: Static scanning detected no dangerous execution, outbound connection, or credential access patterns.

summary.zh: 行为分析未检出安装钩子、混淆载荷或敏感文件读取。
summary.en: Behavior analysis detected no install hooks, obfuscated payloads, or sensitive file reads.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查未检出工具描述投毒或指令文件注入。
summary.en: AI metadata review detected no tool-description poisoning or instruction-file injection.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed at this stage.

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（DG-L4 未启用），静态分析不覆盖全部运行时行为；锁文件根版本号与包版本号存在开发期差异，不影响本审计结论。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (DG-L4 not enabled), and static analysis does not cover all runtime behavior; the lockfile root version and package version have a development-phase difference, which does not affect this audit's conclusion.
